scope: Keep cross-tab workspace updates authoritative when a responsive desktop snapshot exists; a mobile breakpoint must not restore stale shell state over a newer remote dock or appearance preset.

observed_defects.trigger: A second same-origin Editor tab writes an updated shell dock state while the first tab is in the temporary mobile presentation of a saved desktop tab group.
observed_defects.before_fix: Real Chromium failed: after returning to desktop the stale temporary snapshot reopened the right dock; actual {leftOpen:true,rightOpen:true,active:'left'} while the newest shared shell state required {leftOpen:true,rightOpen:false,active:'left'}.
observed_defects.expected: The latest external dock state is authoritative; the discarded responsive snapshot must not resurrect a stale dock.

observed_defects.trigger: A second Editor tab changes the shared appearance preset to canvas while the first is mobile, and the shell storage key silently rejects writes.
observed_defects.before_fix: With the shell-key setItem made a no-op only in the source tab, the appearance-key storage event closed the mobile drawer but desktop restoration timed out because the first tab retained the previous two-dock state.
observed_defects.expected: The shared preset restores its desktop meaning on breakpoint return even if the independent shell key could not be written.

bug_and_fix.fix: Cross-tab appearance and dock events invalidate the temporary desktop snapshot. When an externally received non-custom appearance preset is applied without a shell write, the receiving tab synchronizes its in-memory desktop dock-open flags and active side from that preset. No redundant storage write is issued.
bug_and_fix.cache_busting: Bumped the editor shell entry and workspace-appearance module query to 20261105-cross-tab-workspace-lifecycle.
bug_and_fix.data_boundary: No Page Model, page Save, Publish, renderer, D1 write/migration, or R2 operation is involved.
